title: Annual free-market USD/toman rate + CPI inflation 1390-1400 (project-supplied)
notes: Supplied 2026-10-06 via a developer handoff. fx_toman_usd: 1200 ... 28000, one value per year; the handoff does not state the definition, the values track year-end free-market rates rather than annual averages, and the definition must be confirmed before publication. inflation_pct: USED ONLY FOR 1390-1396 -- the 1397-1400 rows were replaced by S18 on 2026-10-08. The 1390-1396 values (21.5/30.5/34.7/15.6/11.9/9.0/10.0) are consistent with SCI's published annual-average rates for those years, but no citation is held for them yet; treat as UNVERIFIED until checked against SCI. Note the 1399 and 1400 rows already matched SCI (36.0 vs 36.4, 40.0 vs 40.2) while 1397 and 1398 did not (18.0 vs 26.9, 41.0 vs 34.8), i.e. the old column was SCI with two bad years, not a different measure.

title: SCI (مرکز آمار ایران) annual-average CPI inflation 1397-1403
notes: Owner-supplied, 2026-10-08: 1397=26.9, 1398=34.8, 1399=36.4, 1400=40.2, 1401=45.8, 1402=40.7, 1403=32.5. Chosen over the World Bank WDI series (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG, IMF IFS-sourced: 31.2/41.2/47.1/43.4/43.5/44.6) because the question is about the Iranian consumer price level and SCI is the domestic official source. The two series are systematically different, not one wrong and one right. Do not splice them: an outside computation that mixed 1397-1399 from WDI with 1402-1403 from SCI understated the FX/CPI ratio (1.48 instead of 1.81). See docs/fx_cpi_source_reconciliation_handoff.md. Stored as data in data/sci_cpi_annual.csv (canonical for SCI); the same four 1397-1400 values are also inline in data/rent_vs_fx/fx_inflation_annual.csv, so a revision must update both. Used by rent-drivers.html as a marker series on the quarterly chart and as annual bars on the growth chart.

title: Free-market USD/toman, sampled every 21 days, during 1401 and 1402 (owner-supplied)
notes: Owner-supplied 2026-10-08: 17 samples running 1401-01-15 to 1401-12-15 and 18 samples running 1402-01-07 to 1402-12-28, every 21 days exactly, toman per USD, from a currency-conversion site. No site name or URL was given, so treat the provenance as weaker than S17. Used to check S17's quarterly FX: the sampled means are 34,655 (1401, time-weighted) and 51,583 (1402) against S17's 40,250 and 53,000, i.e. S17's 1401 is about 14% too high while 1402 is within 3%. 1400 and 1403 were not supplied and remain unchecked. The site also showed a per-row dollar figure that varies (1.05, 0.951395, ...); that column was treated as an artefact and ignored -- only the toman column was used.
